about_the_game:
Wizzo Popout is a fast-paced 3D top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. Play as an arcane wizzo riding a bouncing magical bubble! Cast cool spells, dodge enemy blasts, and knock your rivals out of the arena in hilariously chaotic battles.

What's Poppin'?

Choose from a variety of unique magic bubble spells to dominate your opponents in either local or online multiplayer action.

Combine spells to create a chaos inflicting loadout!

The Spells:

  • Rapid Bubble Bottle

  • Sniper Bubble Blowpipe

  • Six-Shooter

  • Giant Bubble Blunderbuss

  • Explosive Rocket Bubble

  • The Winged Homing Bubble

  • Bubble Shield

  • Slippery Soap

Change your loadout at any time to stay flexible and POP THEM WIZZOS OUT!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel i3 Processor or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce MXM 110 / AMD equivalent / OpenGL 4.3+ compatible GPU
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel i5 Processor or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 960+ / AMD equivalent / Vulkan-supported GPU
  • Storage: 8 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Dual-Core) or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics / Apple M1 integrated GPU
  • Storage: 250 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 / M3 or Intel Core i5 (Quad-Core)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU (M1/M2/M3 series)
  • Storage: 512 GB available space
